Data Collection & Directory Creation

ko_abundance_shotgun <- read_tsv("data/DM_KOs_shotgun.tsv")
metadata <- read_excel("data/metadata.xlsx")
hmdb <- read_csv("../../Code_Projs/DietMicrobeNet/Data/hmdb.csv") %>%
  distinct() %>%
  na.omit()
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Split a HUMAnN-style gene family table into per-sample outputs.
#
# For each sample column (i.e. every column except "Gene Family"):
#   <sample_name>/
#     ko_taxonomy_abundance.csv   -> KO, taxonomy, Abundance_RPKs
#     noquote_ko.txt              -> unique list of KOs (no quotes)
#
# Filtering rules:
#   - Drop rows whose Gene Family is "UNGROUPED" or starts with "UNGROUPED|"
#   - Drop rows where that sample's abundance is 0
#   - Drop blank taxonomy rows 
# Copy host (human) whole genome KOs
# Copy sample FFQ from intervention by diet assigned to patient 
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

out_root <- "participants/"

gene_family_col <- names(ko_abundance_shotgun)[1]      # "Gene Family"
sample_cols     <- names(ko_abundance_shotgun)[-1]     # everything else

# Drop UNGROUPED rows up front (exact "UNGROUPED" or "UNGROUPED|...")
keep_rows <- !(ko_abundance_shotgun[[gene_family_col]] == "UNGROUPED" |
               startsWith(ko_abundance_shotgun[[gene_family_col]], "UNGROUPED|") |
               ko_abundance_shotgun[[gene_family_col]] == "UNMAPPED" |
               startsWith(ko_abundance_shotgun[[gene_family_col]], "UNMAPPED|"))
ko_abundance_shotgun <- ko_abundance_shotgun[keep_rows, ]

# Split "Gene Family" into KO and taxonomy on the first "|"
split_gf <- strsplit(ko_abundance_shotgun[[gene_family_col]], "|", fixed = TRUE)
KO       <- vapply(split_gf, `[`, character(1), 1)
taxonomy <- vapply(split_gf, function(x) if (length(x) > 1) x[2] else "", character(1))

# Drop rows with no taxonomy (blank string, since no "|" was present)
has_taxonomy <- taxonomy != ""
KO       <- KO[has_taxonomy]
taxonomy <- taxonomy[has_taxonomy]
ko_abundance_shotgun       <- ko_abundance_shotgun[has_taxonomy, ]

for (sample in sample_cols) {

  abundance <- ko_abundance_shotgun[[sample]]

  # Filter: nonzero abundance for this sample 
  nonzero <- abundance != 0

  sample_ko_abundance_shotgun <- data.frame(
    KO              = KO[nonzero],
    taxonomy        = taxonomy[nonzero],
    Abundance_RPKs  = abundance[nonzero],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  # Create per-sample directory
  sample_dir <- file.path(out_root, sample)
  dir.create(sample_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  
  # Copy patient-specific document based on metadata
  diet_type <- metadata %>% 
    filter(SampleID == sample) %>% 
    pull(Diet) %>% 
    first()
  if(diet_type == "Agrarian"){
    file.copy(from = "data/ag_foodb/foodb_foods_dataframe.csv", to = sample_dir, overwrite = T)
  }else{
    file.copy(from = "data/ws_foodb/foodb_foods_dataframe.csv", to = sample_dir, overwrite = T)
  }

  # Write ko_taxonomy_abundance.csv
  write.csv(sample_ko_abundance_shotgun,
            file = file.path(sample_dir, "ko_taxonomy_abundance.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

  # Write noquote_ko.txt - unique KOs, no quotes, one per line
  unique_kos <- unique(sample_ko_abundance_shotgun$KO)
  writeLines(unique_kos, con = file.path(sample_dir, "noquote_ko.txt"))

  # Copy host whole genome information 
  files_to_copy <- c("data/noquote_ko_host.txt", "data/host_ko_abundance.csv")  
  file.copy(from = files_to_copy,
            to   = sample_dir,
            overwrite = TRUE)
}
sampleids <- colnames(ko_abundance_shotgun)[-1]
metadata %>% 
  filter(SampleID %in% sampleids) %>% 
  select(SampleID, Diet) %>% 
  group_by(Diet) %>% 
  summarise(n_diet = n())
## # A tibble: 2 × 2
##   Diet     n_diet
##   <chr>     <int>
## 1 Agrarian      7
## 2 Western       9

DietMicrobe[Host]Net

In this analysis, all samples who were shotgun sequenced were taken and run through DM[H]N with host and all foods.

  • Results in a Diet-Microbe-Host (3-node) pattern w/ all foods

Aggregate pattern results

files <- list.files(
  "participants",
  pattern = "graph_results\\.csv$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
) |>
  str_subset("output_dmh/graph/")

all_data <- files |>
  set_names() |>
  map_dfr(read_csv, .id = "path") |>
  mutate(ID = str_extract(path, "(?<=participants/)[^/]+")) |>
  select(ID, everything(), -path)

length(unique(all_data$ID)) # there should be 16 
## [1] 16

Q1: What dietary compounds were used by the microbes? (node 1)

# get a number of diets assigned to each recordID
metadata %>% 
  group_by(RecordID) %>% 
  summarise(
    n_diets    = n_distinct(Diet, na.rm = TRUE),
    diets_seen = paste(unique(na.omit(Diet)), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) -> diet_check

# Which patients have more than one diet (answer = none)
diet_check %>% filter(n_diets > 1)
## # A tibble: 0 × 3
## # ℹ 3 variables: RecordID <chr>, n_diets <int>, diets_seen <chr>
# clean id column to match metadata
all_data$RecordID <- sub("\\.1$", "", all_data$ID)

# merge with dietary metadata information 
metadata %>% 
  select(RecordID, Diet) %>% 
  unique() %>% 
  right_join(all_data, by = "RecordID") -> results

# are there patterns that are exactly diet -> microbe -> host 
results %>% 
  filter(compound1_origin == "Diet" & compound2_origin == "microbe" & compound3_origin == "host")
## # A tibble: 0 × 25
## # ℹ 25 variables: RecordID <chr>, Diet <chr>, ID <chr>, compound1_id <chr>,
## #   compound1_origin <chr>, compound1_assoc_food <chr>, compound1_freq <dbl>,
## #   edge1_reaction <chr>, edge1_KOs <chr>, edge1_organisms <chr>,
## #   edge1_m_abundance <dbl>, edge1_h_abundance <dbl>, compound2_id <chr>,
## #   compound2_origin <chr>, compound2_assoc_food <chr>, compound2_freq <dbl>,
## #   edge2_reaction <chr>, edge2_KOs <chr>, edge2_organisms <chr>,
## #   edge2_m_abundance <dbl>, edge2_h_abundance <dbl>, compound3_id <chr>, …
# make hmdb key
hmdb_u <- hmdb %>% distinct(kegg_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

n_pat <- results %>%
  filter(!is.na(Diet)) %>%
  distinct(RecordID, Diet) %>%
  count(Diet, name = "n_pat")

# ---- wide -> long: one row per patient x node x compound ---------------------
long <- results %>%
  filter(!is.na(Diet)) %>%
  select(RecordID, Diet, matches("^compound[123]_(id|origin)$")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(RecordID, Diet),
               names_to    = c("node", ".value"),
               names_pattern = "compound(\\d)_(id|origin)") %>%     # columns: node, id, origin
  rename(kegg_id = id) %>%
  mutate(node = paste("Node", node)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(kegg_id)) %>%
  distinct(RecordID, Diet, node, origin, kegg_id)                    # removes the repeats from the path structure

# ---- summarise once for all nodes -------------------------------------------
heat_dat <- long %>%
  left_join(hmdb_u, by = "kegg_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(taxonomy_class)) %>%
  count(Diet, node, origin, taxonomy_super_class, taxonomy_class, name = "n") %>%
  left_join(n_pat, by = "Diet") %>%
  mutate(mean_per_patient = n / n_pat)

# ---- one plot ----------------------------------------------------------------
heat_dat %>% 
  mutate(node = case_when(node == "Node 1" ~ "1", 
                          node == "Node 2" ~ "2", 
                          node == "Node 3" ~ "3"), 
         taxonomy_super_class = str_remove(taxonomy_super_class, "compounds")) %>% 
ggplot(aes(x = node, y = taxonomy_class, fill = mean_per_patient)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#00203FFF", high = "#ADEFD1FF",
                      name = "Mean compounds\nper patient",
                      trans = "log10", labels = label_comma()) +
  facet_grid(taxonomy_super_class ~ origin,
             scales = "free", space = "free",
             labeller = label_wrap_gen(width = 20)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0)) +
  labs(x = "Node", y = "Chemical Taxonomy Class") -> p_nodes_origin

Q2: What is the host capable of doing? (edge 2)

# ---- 1. Host KOs reachable from the microbiome -----------------------------------
host_kos <- read_csv("data/noquote_ko_host.txt", col_names = "ko")

# turn "['K001', 'K002']" strings into character vectors
parse_py_list <- function(x) {
  str_extract_all(x, "'([^']*)'") %>%
    map(~ str_remove_all(.x, "'"))
}

kos <- results %>%
  filter(edge1_m_abundance > 0) %>%          # only edges whose microbial step has reads
  distinct(RecordID, edge2_KOs) %>%          # collapse the repeats from the path structure
  mutate(ko = parse_py_list(edge2_KOs)) %>%
  unnest(ko) %>%
  distinct(RecordID, ko) %>%
  filter(ko %in% host_kos$ko)                # keep KOs present in the host reference genome

# KOs to test: those found in at least `min_patients` patients
# (1 = any patient; raise it so that a KO carried by a single person can't drive a pathway)
min_patients <- 1
ko_set <- kos %>% count(ko) %>% filter(n >= min_patients) %>% pull(ko)

# ---- 2. KEGG enrichment ------------------------------------------------------------
# Background = every KO in the host reference genome, so the question is whether the
# reachable KOs are concentrated in particular pathways relative to all the host can do.
# (universe = NULL would compare against all of KEGG, which mostly reflects "these are metabolic genes".)
enrich_host <- enrichKEGG(
  gene          = unique(ko_set),
  organism      = "ko",
  keyType       = "kegg",
  universe      = unique(host_kos$ko),
  pvalueCutoff  = 1,                         # keep every term; filter on p.adjust below
  qvalueCutoff  = 1,
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  minGSSize     = 5,
  maxGSSize     = 500
)

enrich_host_df <- as.data.frame(enrich_host)
# enrich_host_df <- enrich_host_df %>% filter(subcategory != "Global and overview maps")   # optional: drop the umbrella maps

# ---- 3. Plot significant pathways ------------------------------------------------
sig <- enrich_host_df %>% filter(p.adjust < 0.05)

# are there NAs
sum(is.na(sig$category))
## [1] 1
# add category and subcatgory for: ko04981 | Folate transport and metabolism
sig[is.na(sig$category), "category"] <- "Organismal Systems"
sig[is.na(sig$category), "subcategory"] <- "Digestive system"

sum(is.na(sig$category)) # sanity check
## [1] 0
ggplot(sig, aes(x = reorder(Description, -log10(p.adjust)), y = Count, fill = p.adjust)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_grid(category ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y",
             labeller = labeller(.rows = label_wrap_gen(width = 13))) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "red", high = "blue") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
        strip.clip = "off",
        axis.text.y = element_text(lineheight = 0.8, vjust = 0.5)) +
  labs(x = "Pathway", y = "Gene Count", title = "Host KEGG Enrichment") -> p_host_enrichment
p_host_enrichment

ggsave(filename = "figures/host_gene_enrichment.png", p_host_enrichment, 
       width = 10, height = 15)
# =============================================================================
# Do host-KO counts, and the variation in which KOs a patient carries,
# relate to changes in clinical markers (week 2 / week 3 minus week 1)?
#
# Needs in the session:
#   results  : aggregated graph_results for all patients (RecordID + graph columns)
#   metadata : RecordID, Week, Diet, and the marker columns
#   sig      : KEGG enrichment table for the host KOs (category, subcategory,
#              Description, geneID, ...)
#
# Part 0  Parameters
# Part 1  Data: pathway KOs, patient KOs, marker changes
# Part 2  Question 1: does the NUMBER of KOs relate to marker change?  (Plot 1)
# Part 3  Question 2: does WHICH KOs a patient carries relate to it?   (Plots 2, 3)
# =============================================================================

# ---- 0. Parameters: revisit these when more samples arrive ----------------------
markers_keep    <- c("LDL", "HDL", "IL6", "CRP", "LBP",
                     "CD4+CD40+", "CD4+ PD1+", "CD8+CD40+", "CD8+PD1+")
drop_overview   <- TRUE   # drop KEGG "Global and overview maps" (they repeat the specific pathways)
min_pairs       <- 8      # min patients with data for a count correlation
min_pairs_model <- 10     # min patients for the regression models
min_minor       <- 2      # a KO must be present in >= this many patients and absent in >= this many
min_blocks      <- 2      # a pathway needs >= this many independent KO blocks to be scored

# ---- 1. Data ------------------------------------------------------------------

# 1a. One row per KO in each significantly enriched pathway
sig_ko <- sig %>%
  select(category, subcategory, Description, geneID) %>%
  filter(!(drop_overview & subcategory %in% "Global and overview maps")) %>%
  separate_rows(geneID, sep = "/") %>%                  # "K001/K002/..." -> one row per KO
  rename(ko = geneID) %>%
  distinct()

# 1b. Host KOs available to each patient. Only edges whose microbial step has reads
#     are kept (the graph lists edges even at abundance 0).
host_ko <- results %>%
  filter(edge1_m_abundance > 0) %>%
  distinct(RecordID, edge2_KOs) %>%                     # collapse the repeats from the path structure
  mutate(ko = str_extract_all(edge2_KOs, "K\\d{5}")) %>%
  unnest(ko) %>%
  distinct(RecordID, ko)

# 1c. Patient x pathway x KO (inner join: KOs that no patient has are dropped)
sig_ko_host <- inner_join(sig_ko, host_ko, by = "ko", relationship = "many-to-many")

patients <- unique(host_ko$RecordID)
n_pat    <- length(patients)
diet_key <- metadata %>% distinct(RecordID, Diet)

# 1d. Marker changes: week 2 - week 1 and week 3 - week 1
host_deltas <- metadata %>%
  select(RecordID, Week, all_of(markers_keep)) %>%
  filter(RecordID %in% patients) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(RecordID, Week), names_to = "marker", values_to = "value",
               values_transform = as.numeric) %>%       # some columns are stored as text
  pivot_wider(names_from = Week, values_from = value, names_prefix = "wk") %>%
  mutate(d_wk2 = wk2 - wk1,
         d_wk3 = wk3 - wk1)

# long form: one row per patient x marker x comparison (baseline wk1 kept for adjustment)
deltas_long <- host_deltas %>%
  pivot_longer(c(d_wk2, d_wk3), names_to = "change", values_to = "delta") %>%
  filter(!is.na(delta)) %>%
  left_join(diet_key, by = "RecordID")

# pathway -> category lookup, for facetting
description_category <- sig_ko %>% distinct(Description, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(Description, category)

# ---- 2. QUESTION 1: number of KOs vs marker change ------------------------------
# For each category / subcategory / pathway: Spearman correlation between a patient's
# number of distinct KOs in the group and the marker change.
# NB: broad levels are mostly "total KO count"; the pathway level is the specific one.
cor_by_level <- function(level) {
  sig_ko_host %>%
    distinct(RecordID, group = .data[[level]], ko) %>%
    filter(!is.na(group)) %>%
    count(RecordID, group, name = "n_ko") %>%
    complete(RecordID = patients, group, fill = list(n_ko = 0)) %>%      # patients with none count as 0
    inner_join(deltas_long, by = "RecordID", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
    group_by(group, marker, change) %>%
    filter(n() >= min_pairs, n_distinct(n_ko) > 1, n_distinct(delta) > 1) %>%   # need variation
    summarise(n   = n(),
              rho = cor(n_ko, delta, method = "spearman"),
              p   = suppressWarnings(cor.test(n_ko, delta, method = "spearman")$p.value),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(marker, change) %>% mutate(q = p.adjust(p, "BH")) %>% ungroup() %>%
    mutate(q_all = p.adjust(p, "BH"))                   # across every test at this level
}

cors_levels <- map_dfr(c(category = "category", subcategory = "subcategory", pathway = "Description"),
                       cor_by_level, .id = "level") %>%
  arrange(p)

kableExtra::kable(cors_levels %>% filter(p < 0.05))

  filter(level == "pathway") %>%
  rename(Description = group) %>%
  left_join(description_category, by = "Description") %>%
  mutate(star = if_else(p < 0.05, "*", ""),

# PLOT: look at specific correlated paths (p < 0.05)
intereting_paths <- c("Thiamine metabolism", "Taurine and hypotaurine metabolism",
                      "Phenylalanine, tyrosine and tryptophan biosynthesis",
                      "Pantothenate and CoA biosynthesis", "One carbon pool by folate",
                      "Folate biosynthesis", "Carbon fixation by Calvin cycle",
                      "Arginine biosynthesis", "Phenylalanine metabolism",
                      "Isoquinoline alkaloid biosynthesis")
interesting_cors <- cors_levels %>% 
  filter(level == "pathway", p < 0.05) %>% 
  select(group, marker, change) %>% 
  distinct()

n_sig_ko_host <- sig_ko_host %>% 
  select(RecordID, Description, ko) %>% 
  group_by(RecordID, Description) %>% 
  summarise(n_ko = n()) %>% 
  filter(Description %in% interesting_cors$group) %>% 
  rename("group" = "Description")

deltas_long %>% 
  select(RecordID, marker, change, delta, Diet) %>% 
  left_join(n_sig_ko_host, by = c("RecordID"), relationship = "many-to-many") %>% 
  semi_join(interesting_cors, by = c("change", "marker", "group")) %>% 
  filter(!group%in%intereting_paths) %>% 
  mutate(change = ifelse(change == "d_wk2", "Week 2 - Week 1", "Week 3 - Week 1")) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = delta, y = n_ko, color = Diet)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = F) + 
  stat_cor(method = "spearman", label.x = c(0), label.y.npc = "bottom") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") + 
  facet_grid(group~change + marker, scales = "free", labeller = label_wrap_gen(width = 17)) + 
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0), strip.clip = "off") +
  labs(x = "Delta", y = "Number of KOs") -> p_detailcor_1

  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") + 
  facet_grid(group~marker, scales = "free", labeller = label_wrap_gen(width = 15)) + 
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0), strip.clip = "off") +
  labs(x = "Delta (Week3 - Week2)", y = "Number of KOs") -> p_detailcor_2
p_detailcor_2

ggsave(filename = "figures/p_detailcor_ties.png", p_detailcor_2, 
       width = 10, height = 15)
# ---- 3. QUESTION 2: variation in WHICH KOs a patient carries ---------------------
# Two patients can have the same KO count but different KOs, and KOs on the same edge
# always occur together. So: (1) keep KOs that vary between patients, (2) collapse KOs
# with identical patient profiles into one "block", (3) score each pathway as the share
# of its blocks a patient carries.

# 3a. Patient x KO presence matrix
ko_pa <- sig_ko_host %>% distinct(RecordID, ko) %>% mutate(v = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = ko, values_from = v, values_fill = 0)
mat <- as.matrix(select(ko_pa, -RecordID)); rownames(mat) <- ko_pa$RecordID

# 3b. Informative KOs: present in >= min_minor patients and absent in >= min_minor
prev   <- colSums(mat)
var_ko <- names(prev)[prev >= min_minor & prev <= nrow(mat) - min_minor]

# 3c. Blocks: KOs with identical patient profiles count as one unit
profile <- apply(mat[, var_ko, drop = FALSE], 2, paste, collapse = "")
blocks  <- tibble(ko = var_ko, block = paste0("B", match(profile, unique(profile))))
c(variable_KOs = length(var_ko), independent_blocks = n_distinct(blocks$block))
##       variable_KOs independent_blocks 
##                 50                 16
# ^ the number of independent blocks is how many separate comparisons you really have

bmat <- mat[, var_ko[!duplicated(profile)], drop = FALSE]      # one column per block
colnames(bmat) <- paste0("B", seq_len(ncol(bmat)))
bmat_long <- as_tibble(bmat, rownames = "RecordID") %>%
  pivot_longer(-RecordID, names_to = "block", values_to = "has")

# 3d. Pathway score = share of the pathway's blocks the patient carries (size no longer matters)
pw_block <- sig_ko_host %>% distinct(Description, ko) %>%
  inner_join(blocks, by = "ko") %>% distinct(Description, block)

# pathways with identical block sets give identical results: keep one, remember the others
pw_alias <- pw_block %>%
  group_by(Description) %>%
  summarise(key = paste(sort(block), collapse = "|"), n_blocks = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_blocks >= min_blocks) %>%
  group_by(key) %>%
  summarise(same_as = paste(Description, collapse = "; "), Description = first(Description),
            .groups = "drop")

score <- pw_block %>%
  filter(Description %in% pw_alias$Description) %>%
  inner_join(bmat_long, by = "block", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  group_by(RecordID, Description) %>%
  summarise(frac = mean(has), .groups = "drop")

# 3e. Models per pathway x marker x comparison (ranks, so skew and outliers matter less):
#   main effect:  change ~ score + diet + baseline
#   interaction:  change ~ score * diet + baseline   (does the slope differ by arm?)
# Diet and baseline are included because the change itself contains the diet effect.
fit_models <- possibly(function(d) {
  m1 <- summary(lm(rank(delta) ~ rank(frac) + Diet + rank(wk1), data = d))$coefficients
  m2 <- summary(lm(rank(delta) ~ rank(frac) * Diet + rank(wk1), data = d))$coefficients
  tibble(beta_main     = m1["rank(frac)", "Estimate"],
         p_main        = m1["rank(frac)", "Pr(>|t|)"],
         beta_agrarian = m2["rank(frac)", "Estimate"],           # slope in the reference arm (Agrarian)
         p_agrarian    = m2["rank(frac)", "Pr(>|t|)"],
         beta_diff     = m2["rank(frac):DietWestern", "Estimate"], # how much the Western slope differs
         p_int         = m2["rank(frac):DietWestern", "Pr(>|t|)"])
}, otherwise = tibble(beta_main = NA_real_, p_main = NA_real_, beta_agrarian = NA_real_,
                      p_agrarian = NA_real_, beta_diff = NA_real_, p_int = NA_real_))

model_res <- score %>%
  inner_join(deltas_long, by = "RecordID", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  group_by(Description, marker, change) %>%
  filter(n() >= min_pairs_model, n_distinct(frac) > 2, n_distinct(Diet) == 2) %>%
  nest(data = c(RecordID, frac, delta, wk1, Diet)) %>%
  mutate(res = map(data, fit_models)) %>%
  select(-data) %>% unnest(res) %>% ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(p_main)) %>%
  group_by(marker, change) %>%
  mutate(q_main = p.adjust(p_main, "BH"), q_int = p.adjust(p_int, "BH")) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(q_main_all = p.adjust(p_main, "BH"),            # across everything tested: the conservative one
         q_int_all  = p.adjust(p_int, "BH")) %>%
  left_join(select(pw_alias, Description, same_as), by = "Description") %>%
  arrange(p_int)

model_res %>% filter(p_main < 0.05 | p_int < 0.05)
## # A tibble: 0 × 16
## # ℹ 16 variables: Description <chr>, marker <chr>, wk2 <dbl>, wk3 <dbl>,
## #   change <chr>, beta_main <dbl>, p_main <dbl>, beta_agrarian <dbl>,
## #   p_agrarian <dbl>, beta_diff <dbl>, p_int <dbl>, q_main <dbl>, q_int <dbl>,
## #   q_main_all <dbl>, q_int_all <dbl>, same_as <chr>
results %>% 
  select(RecordID, Diet, edge2_reaction) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  group_by(Diet, RecordID) %>% 
  summarise(n = n()) -> n_rx

metadata %>%
  select(RecordID, LDL, Week) %>%
  filter(Week %in% c(1, 2)) %>%
  mutate(LDL = as.numeric(as.character(LDL))) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Week,
    values_from = LDL,
    names_prefix = "Week_"
  ) %>%
  mutate(LDL_change = Week_2 - Week_1) %>% 
  left_join(n_rx, by = "RecordID") %>% 
  na.omit() %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = n, y = LDL_change, color = Diet)) + 
    geom_point() + 
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = F) +
    stat_cor(method = "pearson") +
    theme_bw() + 
    labs(x = "number of reactions")
